description: Votes of the Swiss National Council since 2007 (legislatures 48–52; Parliamentary Services, ws.parlament.ch; current legislature daily): every electronic vote with business number and title, bill, subject, what yes and no meant, time, totals (yes, no, abstain, excused, did not vote, presiding) and totals per parliamentary group. Without arguments: the final votes (Schlussabstimmungen) with result. With query (words of the title) or business (e.g. 26.033): matching votes. With id: that vote in full incl. how every member voted and the totals per canton. With member (name): add that member's decision to each listed vote. The Council of States' individual votes are not in the data service. For a popular initiative the final vote is on the federal decree carrying the recommendation, not on the initiative itself.

final_only.description: only final votes (default true without id/query/business)

legislature.description: limit a search to one legislature (52 = 2023–2027, 51 = 2019–2023, 50, 49, 48 = 2007–2011); default: all downloaded

name: parliament_vote
